psychological_meaning: Royal Blue is often associated with feelings of trust, loyalty, wisdom, confidence, intelligence, faith, truth, and heaven. It is considered beneficial to the mind and body. It slows human metabolism and produces a calming effect. Royal Blue is strongly associated with tranquility and calmness.
